description: This PHP source file defines the ConsoleMilestoneListener class, an event listener for handling project milestone events such as project publication, activation by days, reward fulfillment, and investment success within the Goteo project. It hooks into various events to trigger milestone creation logic.

classes.name: ConsoleMilestoneListener
classes.description: Event listener class that manages milestones for projects based on events such as publish, activation, reward fulfillment, and investments.

methods.name: create_milestone
methods.description: Creates a new milestone for a given project and type, firing an associated event.

methods.name: onProjectPublish
methods.description: Handles project publish events by creating a 'on-publish' milestone.

methods.name: onProjectActive
methods.description: Handles project activation events based on days, creating a milestone accordingly.

methods.name: onProjectWatch
methods.description: Handles project watch events, creating milestones when rewards are fulfilled or social rewards are fulfilled.

methods.name: onInvestSucceeded
methods.description: Creates milestones based on investment success, considering percentage, amount, and number of donors.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events and corresponding handler methods for subscription.
